jobs.title: Senior Planning Officer (Career Grade)
jobs.description:
**Help shape the future of one of the country’s most varied boroughs**
======================================================================


From historic city streets and major regeneration sites to thriving towns, rural communities and protected countryside, planning in Cheshire West and Chester is rarely ordinary.


We’re looking for a motivated and experienced planner to join our friendly and supportive Development Management team. You’ll take ownership of a varied caseload, apply your professional judgement to interesting and challenging proposals, and have the autonomy to make decisions that deliver positive outcomes for communities across the borough.


Organisation
Cheshire West and Chester Council
Location
Ellesmere Port
Job Category
Environmental and Public Services
Grade
Please refer to advert text
Salary Min
£39,481 per annum
Salary Max
£49,658 per annum
Hours per week
37
Weeks per year
52\.143
Employment Type
Permanent
Closing Date
01/11/2026
Ref No
W4830
Documents  
Cheshire West and Chester Council is a place where everyone can Thrive – through our core values of Teamwork, Honesty, Respect, Innovation, Value for Money and Empowerment.


**The opportunity**
===================


Whether you're an experienced Planner ready for progression or an established Senior Planner looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. This career grade post spans Grades 9 and 10, with the starting grade and salary reflecting your qualifications, experience and professional expertise.
Our borough brings together the historic city of Chester, the towns of Ellesmere Port, Northwich and Winsford, and extensive rural areas, countryside and Green Belt. With around 3,000 planning applications handled each year, no two days \- or cases \-are quite the same.


Your work could include:


* Major housing developments
* Significant commercial, industrial and energy proposals, including development associated with the Origin industrial area
* Agricultural and rural diversification schemes
* Leading visitor destinations such as Chester Zoo, Oulton Park and Chester Racecourse
* Proposals affecting our many conservation areas and listed buildings, and Chester’s Area of Archaeological Importance

It’s a chance to broaden your experience, tackle complex planning issues and see the real\-world impact of your work across the borough.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


You’ll manage and determine a varied caseload of complex planning applications, working with applicants, residents, colleagues and other stakeholders to secure high\-quality, sustainable development.


You may also have opportunities to support our planning enforcement and planning policy teams, giving you wider experience across the service.


**What you’ll bring**
---------------------


We’re looking for someone who:


* Has experience of dealing with varied and complex planning issues, preferably within a local authority
* Communicates clearly and builds effective working relationships
* Can balance competing priorities and take ownership of decisions
* Uses sound professional judgement to find practical solutions
* Is committed to providing great service to applicants, residents and communities

**How we work**


We work as a large, friendly and supportive team, built on trust, autonomy and open communication. We share knowledge, offer different perspectives and tackle challenges together. Managers give you the space to use your professional judgement, while making sure support is there when you need it.


This is a hybrid role, with your time split between home and our modern offices in Ellesmere Port. We support flexible working and a healthy work\-life balance.


Part\-time working arrangements may be considered where the proposed pattern meets the operational needs of the service. If you’re looking to balance the role with family or other commitments, contact us to discuss what could work.


The role involves site visits and remote meetings, so you’ll need a full UK driving licence and access to a car.


**Interested?**
---------------


For an informal conversation about the role, contact:


Nick Smith, Planning Team Manager Nick.Smith2@cheshirewestandchester.gov.uk


To learn more about working for Cheshire West and Chester Council, including our rewards and benefits, visit http://www.cwcrecruitment.co.uk.


For technical enquiries, email Sourcingteam@ecwip.co.uk and quote the job reference number in all correspondence.


Cheshire West and Chester Council is committed to equality and diversity in employment.

**Who is HammerTech?**



As construction’s most trusted safety platform, HammerTech has a team focus where we build safer, smarter, better – *together*. Our workforce is committed to individual and team empowerment so that our innovative approach is sustained, the growth in our capability is continuous and we excel in enhancing safety within the construction industry.



Established in 2013, with the vision of becoming the international benchmark in online safety and quality management, HammerTech is now the leading choice for large construction companies, managing safety and quality for over 500,000 people on construction sites across Australia, New Zealand, North America and Europe.



We offer a hybrid working model to support an inclusive and balanced work culture.



To support the significant growth and development of the organization, we are seeking the expertise and capability of Senior Customer Success Consultant to join our dynamic team.

Please note this post is a fixed\-term appointment to provide coverage during a leave; estimating 12 months but the actual end date may change depending on the substantive postholder’s return\-to\-work date.

* Manage a book of business consisting of primarily Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers within the Customer Success stage in their HammerTech journey, post implementation

	+ Identify lost revenue opportunities
* Protect revenue and renewals for key clients

* Work with customers to resolve any found issues
* Develop and maintain strong, on\-going professional relationships with HammerTech customers

* Ensure contractual obligations and regulatory requirements are met

	+ Expert\-level use of implementation support tools such as Vitally, Wrike, Confluence, PowerBI
* Communicate with other HammerTech functional areas (Marketing, Sales, Product, Technology, etc) on an “as needed basis”
* Maintain a comprehensive knowledge of HammerTech software, its capabilities and competitive edge
* Other duties as required from time to time

  

  

**Are you a good fit? Let’s start with the HammerTech Core Values:**

Everyone at HammerTech lives by our company values of *United, Innovative and Authentic* and we hope you’ll help us bring these to life in your role.



While you may not come from construction or technology, we know you’ll fall in love with the industry. It’s known for passionate and caring people, team players and avid problem solvers who want to build a better world. With your help as Senior Customer Success Consultant, we’ll help construction build safer, smarter, better—*together.*

* Degree or similar or equivalent commercial experience

* Experience in business planning and strategic development
* Experience in process improvement
* Experience within or understanding of the building and construction or similar industry
* Knowledge of the Quality, Health and Safety environment

* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet agreed targets and timelines
* Strong experience utilizing PowerBI

* Outstanding integrity and capacity to maintain strict confidentiality

jobs.title: Facility & Infrastructure Planner
jobs.description:
**Facility \& Infrastructure Planner**

**Department:** Professional Services

**Job Summary**

Multiple locations hiring in Camp Lejeune, NC \& Cherry Point, NC. Concourse Federal Group (Concourse) is seeking a Facility \& Infrastructure Planner to provide non\-personal Advisory and Assistance Services (A\&AS) in support of the Marine Corps Barracks Initiative (MCBI). The Facility \& Infrastructure Planner will support programmatic planning, facility assessments, aviation\-related programming, site development planning, and project documentation for multiple projects across various stages of the project lifecycle. The position will support facility and aviation planning activities, update facility capacity and spatial data in iNFADS, manage complex project requirements within the PAX system, conduct site suitability and aircraft\-clearance\-zone evaluations, perform alternative\-site studies, and develop documentation supporting FSRM and MILCON initiatives. Responsibilities will include preparing Project Requirements Packages, Basic Facilities Requirements (BFRs), site and clearance assessments, DD1391 inputs, Business Case Analyses (BCAs), meeting documentation, and DD1354 closeout coordination in accordance with project\-specific milestones and COR\-established timelines.

Concourse Federal Group partners with federal government clients to solve complex challenges and improve organizational performance. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together expertise in engineering, facilities, utilities, real estate, professional services, space planning, healthcare planning, technology, communications, and acquisition to deliver innovative solutions that support critical federal programs, infrastructure, and mission requirements. Concourse invests in its professionals through training, mentorship, and opportunities for growth, fostering teams equipped to deliver meaningful results for our clients.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

· Support programmatic planning, facility assessments, aviation\-related programming, site development planning, and project documentation across multiple projects and stages of the project lifecycle.

· Perform facility and infrastructure planning in support of FSRM and MILCON initiatives.

· Support aviation facility planning, capacity analysis, and related project development activities.

· Update and maintain facility capacity, spatial, and asset data within iNFADS.

· Manage and update complex project requirements within the PAX system.

· Conduct site suitability evaluations, site analyses, and site\-clearance assessments.

· Perform aircraft\-clearance\-zone site planning and evaluations.

· Conduct alternative\-site and alternative\-use studies to evaluate potential project locations and facility utilization options.

· Develop Project Requirements Packages, including BFRs, site analyses, site approvals, site\-clearance assessments, and DD1391 entries.

· Draft and update DD1391 documentation using the PAX system.

· Prepare Business Case Analyses (BCAs), including alternative\-site BCAs.

· Draft FSRM project packages and supporting documentation.

· Prepare technical stakeholder meeting minutes, meeting summaries, and other project documentation.

· Support DD1354 closeout coordination and related documentation.

· Coordinate with technical stakeholders and project teams to gather, validate, and document facility and project requirements.

· Monitor project milestones, deliverables, and COR\-established timelines.

· Maintain accurate project records, facility data, and supporting documentation.

· Ensure technical deliverables meet project requirements, quality standards, and established timelines.

· Perform other related facility and infrastructure planning duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

· Demonstrated experience in facility, infrastructure, aviation, or site planning.

· Experience supporting facility planning at a Marine Corps or DoD installation.

· Proficiency with Basic Facilities Requirements (BFRs), facility/asset evaluations, iNFADS, and DD1391 development.

· Experience using the PAX system to develop and manage project requirements and DD1391s.

· Experience with site planning, site suitability evaluations, or facility programming.

· Strong analytical, organizational, and technical documentation skills.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Experience supporting Marine Corps aviation facilities or installations.

· Experience with aviation facility programming, aircraft\-clearance\-zone planning, or aviation\-related site development.

· Experience supporting FSRM and MILCON planning and programming.

· Experience with federal facilities, public works, infrastructure, or capital improvement programs.

· Experience preparing Business Case Analyses and Project Requirements Packages.

**Working Conditions**

· Work may include office, client\-site, and field environments.

· Site visits and field activities may be required based on project needs.

· Travel may be required.

· Onsite, hybrid, and remote schedules will be based on the current Task Order, assigned projects, client requirements, and Sr. Project Manager requirements, including coverage, conduct, and performance.

Pay: $89,000\.00 \- $96,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Camp Lejeune, NC 28542

We are currently seeking a Lead Urban Designer to join our team in Boston, Massachusetts.

This is a full\-time, 40\-hour per week position with a hybrid work schedule that allows for remote work on Mondays and Fridays.

The Lead Urban Designer is responsible for providing senior\-level technical leadership to project teams and delivering technically sound urban design solutions that advance the organization’s project portfolio.

This role is a senior\-level technical contributor with project management responsibilities.

**About the Firm**

Planning and design professionals have spent decades talking about the problems with sprawl, but the needle has not moved. Inspire Placemaking Collective, Inc. was founded in 2022, to do something different. Instead of chasing contracts, we partner with cities and counties to drive results.

We are a mission\-driven firm that specializes in planning, landscape architecture, and graphic design. We partner with local governments to create great places, safe streets, and thriving communities and deliver high\-impact projects that put people and communities first.

· Provide senior\-level technical direction across multi\-disciplinary projects that require urban design expertise. Conduct senior\-level technical reviews of project deliverables to ensure accuracy and quality.

· Conduct complex site analyses and other research to evaluate existing physical and spatial conditions and assess community characteristics to help determine project strategies.

· Develop preliminary urban design concepts through drawings, sketches, illustrations, and diagrams to determine effective urban design approaches.

· Develop analytical urban design frameworks, such as site layouts, digital models, maps, and other visualizations, to evaluate urban design alternatives and establish effective solutions.

· Coordinate and contribute to the development of graphics and other visual materials and content for client and stakeholder meetings, community engagement events, public workshops, and charrettes. Ensure client feedback or public input is integrated into recommendations and project deliverables.

· Coordinate and contribute to the technical and design production of reports, presentations, plans, and other technical documentation for project deliverables.

· Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams across the organization to ensure project objectives are achieved on schedule.

· Perform additional duties, as assigned.

***Project Management Responsibilities***

· Lead all phases of projects from planning to delivery, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing and resource allocation, technical production, and quality management.

Coordinate with the Principal\-in\-Charge, as needed.

· Actively monitor project performance against established project plans, including scopes, schedules, budgets, deliverables, and other Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure project objectives are met and remain on target.

· Oversee the technical production and quality of projects, including staffing allocation and coordination and Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) reviews.

· Manage client relationships and expectations through ongoing communication related to project progress and status of deliverables. Address client feedback or other concerns that affect project scope, schedule, budget, technical production, quality, or overall client satisfaction.

· Identify business development opportunities and contribute to efforts to secure new or expanded work, such as participating in industry events or conferences.

· Provide clear direction to project team members related to project assignments, priorities, deadlines, and performance expectations.

· Perform additional duties, as assigned.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams

· Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud software, including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, and related design applications

· Proficiency in Rhino, SketchUp, or a related 3D modeling and design software

· Familiarity with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) software, particularly ArcGIS

· Highly effective written and verbal communication skills

· Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills

· Proven ability to manage complex workloads while consistently meeting deadlines

· Proven ability to work independently and effectively within team environments

jobs.description:
Requisition No: 884718


Agency: Environmental Protection


Working Title: PLANNING ANALYST \- 37020958


Pay Plan: Career Service


Position Number: 37020958


Salary: $53,580\.60


Posting Closing Date: 10/15/2026


**Total Compensation Estimator** **Tool**


**Planning Analyst 37020958**
**Pending Reclassification to Environmental Specialist III \- October 2026**
**State of Florida**
**Department of Environmental Protection**
**Office of Resilience and Coastal Protection**
**This position is located in Tallahassee, FL**

  



**Position Overview and Responsibilities:**


In carrying out the duties of this position, the incumbent is expected at all times to be aware of and abide by the Department's Standards of Conduct, as well as any and all departmental and/or the work unit rules, directives, policies, procedures and/or general orders applicable to perform the duties of this position.


This intermediate environmental position will support the Florida Resilient Program and requires a broad working knowledge of engineering, geology, data science, GIS, and environmental science. Provides technical assistance for planning, funding, permitting, and monitoring of resilience adaptation projects, as well as assisting in the development of policy and procedures. This position requires effective communication and coordination with staff, grant applicants, regional planners, local, state, and federal governmental agencies, and other departmental entities in pursuit of the overall mission to improve resilience to coastal and inland flooding for the state’s critical assets.


Specific duties and responsibilities include:


* Technical environmental program support for Florida Resilient grants. This includes aiding the grant manager on deliverable reviews, grant workplan reviews, scope of work changes, and eligibility issues. Assists with the development of guidelines for the review of project data and the criteria for compliance with statutes, rules and policies related to coastal construction and environmental resources.
* Conducts technical reviews of proposed adaptation projects, resilience related monitoring data, and analysis of vulnerability studies. Provides written comments to the project manager. Participates in meetings as necessary with designated staff to discuss projects and to coordinate the completion of technical reviews.
* Assists with resilience related projects and processes in collaboration with ORCP staff and contractors and prepares reports with recommendations for long\-term strategies.
* Assists Field Staff with on\-site or virtual inspections, as needed, to evaluate project tasks and deliverables, grant compliance and project performance.
* Assists in review of grant applications. Identifies and documents eligible entities and projects based on application and statute. Evaluates and scores applications. Provides QA support on application evaluations. Works with planning, GIS, and SalesForce team to enhance evaluation process and provide training materials.
* Assist in any other Florida Resilient projects funded by the section or DEP. Duties include data review, data creation, deliverable review, scope of work (SOW) creation, report writing, project management assistance, coordination with other sections, and invoicing.
* Assists in development and review of data products used to analyze program information and streamline processes. This may involve geodatabases, spatial layers, dashboards, mobile applications, Salesforce data sources and coordination with GIS section.
* Coordinate with planning section on education and outreach. This includes developing training materials for applicants and grantees, attending workshops/conferences/open houses, and acting as backup on event scheduling and logistics.
* Represents the Florida Resilient staff in meetings with applicants, at public meetings, and at Department and interagency discussions related to projects and policy issues.
* The position also coordinates with the other sections and program areas of the Department in pursuit of the overall mission to preserve, restore and protect the environment and natural resources of Florida.
* In performing the duties of this position, the incumbent will need to develop and maintain working knowledge, skills and abilities in resilience or engineering; and knowledge of the statutes, rules, and policies related to coastal construction and environmental resources, pursuant to Chapters 161, 373 and 403, Florida Statutes.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**


* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, and ArcGIS desktop and mobile applications.
* Ability to apply critical thinking for planning/infrastructure problems.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and manage time efficiently.

### **Position**

From 1946, people of the House of Parfums Christian Dior in France and around the world embody the spirit of excellence, creativity, and the unique savoir\-faire of its creator, the couturier\-perfumer Christian Dior. Revolutionizing the codes of French elegance and luxury with its perfumes, combining tradition and daring innovation in makeup and skincare, we reinvent every day the Dior style and affirm beauty and joy in its entirety.


Parfums Christian Dior invites you today to join its North America teams.


Parfums Christian Dior is part of the LVMH Group.  



The Assistant Planner plays a crucial role in supporting the planning team in optimizing inventory levels, forecasting product demand, and ensuring efficient product flow within the beauty supply chain. This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop foundational planning skills and gain comprehensive experience in the beauty retail sector.


The Assistant Planner will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including merchandising, sales, and logistics, to achieve business objectives and enhance product availability for our clients. This role also plays a key part in bridging planning and field execution, ensuring store teams are equipped with clear, timely insights on inventory, launches, and priorities to drive strong in\-store execution and maximize retail performance.


### **Job responsibilities**

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

**Inventory Management \& Allocation:**

* Review and manage in\-stock positions for core and new products at the SKU/store level to maintain healthy inventory levels.
* Oversee product allocations with analytical insights to support sales performance.
* Track and manage purchase orders (POs) from creation to timely receipt, ensuring accurate pricing, case packs, and delivery windows.
* Support the replenishment process, planning and monitoring inventory levels based on sales and stock throughout the season.
* Ensure timely receipt of inventory for new product launches, promotional events (e.g., Holiday, testers, sampling), and communicate any potential risks.
* Close purchase orders regularly to ensure inventory is accurately captured in replenishment systems.

**Forecasting \& Analysis:**

* Assist in analyzing new product launch performance and seasonality, adjusting forecasts, receipts, and inventory levels as needed to drive business.
* Generate weekly reports on vendor/brand fill rates and lead time accuracy.
* Prepare analyses of location performance, best sellers/slow sellers, and sell\-through rates.
* Report updated business trends and stock continuity weekly to cross\-functional teams.
* Partner with planning teams to refine forecasts based on launch performance, event cadence, and evolving business trends.

**Collaboration \& Communication:**

* Liaise with internal and external partners (e.g., Sephora, supply chain) to resolve PO discrepancies and ensure on\-time delivery.
* Communicate and escalate late key launches to the Planner and Merchant team, focusing on inventory strategy.
* Partner with buying/merchandising counterparts to ensure SKUs are set up correctly for ordering purposes.
* Maintain constant communication with the logistics center to anticipate increased picking/deliveries and sales cycles for key events.
* Communicate timely updates to field teams on inventory availability, launch timing, and key priorities to support strong in\-store execution and alignment at the door level.
* Provide clear, actionable guidance to field partners to ensure awareness of stock flow, merchandising priorities, and any risks impacting store performance.

**Systems \& Data Management**

* Set up new SKUs in planning systems to enable accurate purchasing, allocation, and replenishment.
* Maintain and update purchase order (PO) tracking logs, ensuring visibility to shipping status, delivery timing, and potential delays.
* Review and manage SKU lifecycle status, including activating and deactivating items for replenishment based on assortment and inventory strategy.
* Ensure data accuracy across systems to support reporting, forecasting, and inventory visibility.
* Support updates to merchandising and assortment systems to reflect planogram changes, newness launches, and promotional setups.
### **Profile**

* Supply Chain Management, Merchandising, or a related field experience preferred
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in planning, inventory management, or a similar analytical role, preferably within the beauty or retail industry preferred
* Strong analytical aptitude and strategic thinking skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, logical formulas).
* Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for the beauty industry and awareness of current market trends **.**
### **Additional information**

This job description is intended to cover the core accountabilities of the position and is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Department:** Professional Services

**Job Summary**

Multiple locations hiring in Camp Lejeune, NC \& Cherry Point, NC. Concourse Federal Group (Concourse) is seeking a Facility \& Infrastructure Planner to provide non\-personal Advisory and Assistance Services (A\&AS) in support of the Marine Corps Barracks Initiative (MCBI). The Facility \& Infrastructure Planner will support programmatic planning, facility assessments, aviation\-related programming, site development planning, and project documentation for multiple projects across various stages of the project lifecycle. The position will support facility and aviation planning activities, update facility capacity and spatial data in iNFADS, manage complex project requirements within the PAX system, conduct site suitability and aircraft\-clearance\-zone evaluations, perform alternative\-site studies, and develop documentation supporting FSRM and MILCON initiatives. Responsibilities will include preparing Project Requirements Packages, Basic Facilities Requirements (BFRs), site and clearance assessments, DD1391 inputs, Business Case Analyses (BCAs), meeting documentation, and DD1354 closeout coordination in accordance with project\-specific milestones and COR\-established timelines.

Concourse Federal Group partners with federal government clients to solve complex challenges and improve organizational performance. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together expertise in engineering, facilities, utilities, real estate, professional services, space planning, healthcare planning, technology, communications, and acquisition to deliver innovative solutions that support critical federal programs, infrastructure, and mission requirements. Concourse invests in its professionals through training, mentorship, and opportunities for growth, fostering teams equipped to deliver meaningful results for our clients.

· Support programmatic planning, facility assessments, aviation\-related programming, site development planning, and project documentation across multiple projects and stages of the project lifecycle.
